name: Amartha 10X Run
short_description: A half marathon and 10 km run on 6 September 2026 from Plaza Parkir Timur, Gelora Bung Karno, Senayan, Jakarta, Indonesia, with normal entry fees of IDR 450,000 (10 km) and IDR 650,000 (half).
ai_summary: The Amartha 10X Run was run on Sunday 6 September 2026 from Plaza Parkir Timur, Gelora Bung Karno (GBK), in Senayan, Jakarta, Indonesia. It offered a half marathon, which started at 5am with a four-hour limit, and a 10 km, which started at 5.20am with a two-hour limit. Normal entry fees were IDR 650,000 for the half and IDR 450,000 for the 10 km.
pros: Water every 2 km on the half marathon, with fruit, gel and sponge stations
Both distances run up Sudirman to Bundaran HI in central Jakarta
Free race-morning shuttle and a race village with free fruit, vegetables and betta fish
cons: Half marathoners must reach 15.8 km by 8.12am, and it was 31°C by 9am in 2026
Two-hour 10K limit: 104 runners finished outside it in 2026 and got no medal
Race packs must be collected in person or by a representative in the two days before the race
research_highlights: The 2026 edition took place on Sunday 6 September 2026, starting and finishing on Jl. Apec by Plaza Parkir Timur, Gelora Bung Karno (GBK), Senayan, with 10K and Half Marathon categories.
Cut-off times are set at 2 hours for the 10K and 4 hours for the Half Marathon.
The half marathon route extends beyond Sudirman/Bundaran HI into Senopati, Prapanca, and Blok M before returning to the finish, while the 10K stays within the GBK–Sudirman–Bundaran HI corridor.
Water stations for half marathon runners were placed every 2 kilometres, which the organiser described as closer than the World Athletics standard of every 5 kilometres.
Start time for the 2026 race is 05:00 WIB, and the event includes a themed 'Race Village' with rural-market/UMKM booths, traditional games, and local produce for participants to explore post-race.
research_watchouts: Available research consists almost entirely of official press releases and organizer/sponsor statements (Amartha, race director Satrio Guardian, SVP Sheldon Chuan) rather than independent participant race reports, so on-the-ground runner feedback (heat, crowding, logistics complaints) could not be verified.
No participant reviews, forum discussions, or Strava/community race reports discussing course conditions, heat, or organizational issues were found for this event at the time of research.

faqs.question: When was the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: The Amartha 10X Run 2026 was run on Sunday 6 September 2026 at Gelora Bung Karno in Senayan, Jakarta. The half marathon was flagged off at 5am and the 10 km at 5.20am. Race packs were collected on 4 and 5 September at Lippo Mall Nusantara on Jalan Jenderal Sudirman.

faqs.question: Where is the Amartha 10X Run held?
faqs.answer: The race started and finished on Jalan Apec beside Plaza Parkir Timur at Gelora Bung Karno (GBK), Senayan, Jakarta, according to the race book updated on 3 September. Both courses ran north up Jalan Jenderal Sudirman to Bundaran HI; the half marathon then continued south through Senopati and Prapanca Raya.

faqs.question: What distance options are available for the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: The race offered two distances: a half marathon, measured at 21.0975 km in the race book, and a 10 km. The half marathon was the main race, with a four-hour limit and a cut-off at 15.8 km by 8.12am. The 10 km had a two-hour limit. Runners had to be 17 or older.

faqs.question: How much does registration cost for the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: Normal entry cost IDR 650,000 for the half marathon and IDR 450,000 for the 10 km, according to the official race-info page. Fees were not refundable, and registrations and bib numbers could not be transferred or sold. Finishers inside the cut-off received a medal, and half marathon finishers also received a finisher jersey.
